CDIAL 13943.3 *haṇṭ explicitly gives Bengali hā̃ṭā to walk. Nasalized hãṭa selects section 3, not aspirated *haṭṭh in section 2. Exact survey form hãʈa is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 3144 kiṃcid explicitly gives Bengali kichu something/anything alongside the some/a little senses in neighboring languages. Survey kɪtʃhu some matches this indefinite pronoun. Exact survey form kɪtʃhu is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 9538 *bhull section 1 gives Bengali bhulā err/forget, with a nominal bhūl mistake in the addenda. Bengali bhul wrong is compared with that error family, retaining the survey adjectival gloss; section 2 *bhol lead astray is distinct. Exact survey form bhul is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 10158 mukha means mouth/face; CDIAL 10174 explicitly prefers mukha with expressive doubling for several retained-kh forms rather than mukhya chief. Bagheli mukh face/mouth is linked to the mouth noun, leaving learned versus vernacular transmission open. Exact survey form mukh is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 6089 *thaṭṭha explicitly gives Hindi ṭhāṭh frame of a roof and Old Awadhi ṭhāṭa frame on which thatch is laid. Bagheli ṭhaṭh roof is compared with that roof-frame noun, preserving the broader survey roof gloss. Exact survey form ṭhaṭh is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 137 aṅguṣṭha includes Marathi ãgṭhī little finger/toe and Oriya āṅgṭhi finger/toe. Pauri aŋṭhi finger fits the shortened finger family, with medial g loss retained as a regional phonetic qualification. Exact survey form aŋṭhi is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 5023 chādya section 1 explicitly gives Braj chajjo/chājo veranda/roof in the addenda, alongside Nepali chajjā roof/balcony. Mewari chajo roof matches this j branch, not section 2 chādiya. Exact survey form chajo is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 12311 śamba gives Gujarati sā̃belũ/sāmelũ wooden pestle. Mewari hamela pestle is compared with that whole regional noun; initial h versus s and its ending are retained as regional comparative qualifications, with intra-Indo-Aryan transmission open. Exact survey form hamela is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.
CDIAL 5103 jani explicitly gives Gujarati, Punjabi and Lahnda jaṇī woman. Mewari jaṇi woman directly matches this noun. Exact survey form jaṇi is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 9273.10 *bodda gives Punjabi boddā rotten, Hindi bodā weak and related defective senses. Mewari boda bad is compared with this specific dental-d family, retaining the broad evaluative gloss. Exact survey form boda is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 400 anyatara explicitly gives Gujarati nerũ another/different/extraordinary/many. Mewari naro many is compared with that regional many sense, with the vowel and masculine ending retained and the precise transmission open. Exact survey form naro is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 3546 koṣṭha explicitly gives Lahnda/Awan koṭhā house and Punjabi koṭhā house. Pothohari koṭha house directly matches this regional house noun. Exact survey form koṭʰa is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 6906 na gives Lahnda and Punjabi na not, with nā̃ no in the addenda. Pothohari nã not is compared with this negative particle, retaining nasalization. Exact survey form nã is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 13355 sāra explicitly gives Gujarati sārũ good/whole. Goj saru good is compared with this adjectival good sense; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact survey form saru is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 10555 *rakṣāpuṭaka explicitly gives Gujarati rākhɔṛɔ ashes/layers of ashes. Vasavi rakhaḍo ash fits this expanded ash noun; retroflex stop versus flap and the source vowel lengths are retained. Exact survey form rakhaḍo is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 10188 *muṭṭa heart gives Nepali muṭu heart/courage. Dang moṭu heart is compared in this family with o versus u retained; the immediate Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact survey form moṭu is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.
